item.title: Does coding with LLMs mean more microservices?
item.description:
📝 Does coding with LLMs mean more microservices. A microservice has much less risk of coupling. When you have dozens of apps (all with their own billing accounts, hosting setups, and resources) it’s a lot easier to forget to renew that OpenAI API account that only your image-generation microservice hosted on Vercel uses.
🔗 Read more: https://ben.page/microservices
